formulas.ascii: On one segment pair common time interval of span T: closest=clamp(-dot(D,V)/dot(V,V),0,T) for nonzero relative velocity V, else 0; d*=length(D+V*closest). D is separation at the common start. Quadratic roots bound the interval within distance. Track-pair output takes the minimum over hit segment pairs, earliest time on ties, and sums their encounter durations; times are relative to the lower track start.

formulas.ascii: y[i] = sum(x[s(i)..i-1+delta]) mod 2^32; delta=0 exclusive (default), 1 inclusive; s(i) is the last nonzero segment flag or 0.

o[i]=exclusive uint32 scan(flags); if flags[i]!=0 and o[i] is in output capacity, y[o[i]]=x[i]. count=(o[n-1]+min(flags[n-1],1)) mod 2^32, empty=0. Dense stable compaction requires binary flags; raw nonbinary flags leave gaps.
